title: CRE-Ter enhances murine bone differentiation, improves muscle cell atrophy, and increases irisin expression.
authors: Jantarawong, Sompot; Khimmaktong, Wipapan; Panichayupakaranant, Pharkphoom; Pengjam, Yutthana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素提取物对骨分化、肌萎缩及irisin表达的影响，仅用分子对接模拟小分子与irisin的相互作用，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ternary complex of curcuminoid-rich extract (CRE-Ter) is a developed water-soluble Curcuma longa extract containing 14% w/w curcuminoids, hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin, and polyvinylpyrrolidone K30. This study aimed to investigate the biomolecular effects of CRE-Ter on differentiation of bone cells (murine MC3T3-E1 preosteoblasts), muscle cells (murine dexamethasone-treated C2C12 myotubes) atrophy and irisin expression. In MC3T3-E1 preosteoblasts, CRE-Ter treatment increased alkaline phosphatase activity, calcium deposition, and expression of Bmp-2, Runx2, and collagen 1a significantly and dose-dependently. 5, 10, and 20 microg/mL CRE-Ter upregulated beta-catenin expression significantly. CRE-Ter improved the atrophy of dexamethasone-treated C2C12 myotubes. CRE-Ter decreased proinflammatory cytokine (TNF-alpha and IL-6) expression but increased FNDC5 and irisin expression and nitric oxide production in dexamethasone-treated C2C12 myotubes significantly and dose-dependently. Dexamethasone promoted beta-catenin and total p38 expression in C2C12 myotubes. CRE-Ter at 2.5-20 microg/mL reversed the increase in beta-catenin expression, whereas 2.5 microg/mL reversed total p38 expression. Crosstalk experiments further revealed that conditioned medium from C2C12 myotubes enhanced osteocalcin expression in MC3T3-E1 osteoblasts. Molecular docking simulations using CB-Dock2 showed strong interactions between each curcuminoid molecule and irisin. Therefore, CRE-Ter may stimulate osteoblast differentiation, ameliorate myotube atrophy, and increase irisin expression, indicating its therapeutic potential in osteoporosis, sarcopenia, and osteosarcopenia.
abstract_zh: 富含姜黄素类化合物的三元复合物（CRE-Ter）是一种开发的水溶性姜黄提取物，含有14% w/w的姜黄素类化合物、羟丙基-β-环糊精和聚乙烯吡咯烷酮K30。本研究旨在探讨CRE-Ter对骨细胞（小鼠MC3T3-E1前成骨细胞）分化、肌细胞（小鼠地塞米松处理的C2C12肌管）萎缩及irisin表达的生物分子效应。在MC3T3-E1前成骨细胞中，CRE-Ter处理显著且剂量依赖性地增加了碱性磷酸酶活性、钙沉积以及Bmp-2、Runx2和胶原蛋白1a的表达。5、10和20微克/毫升的CRE-Ter显著上调了β-catenin表达。CRE-Ter改善了地塞米松处理的C2C12肌管的萎缩。CRE-Ter显著且剂量依赖性地降低了地塞米松处理的C2C12肌管中促炎细胞因子（TNF-α和IL-6）的表达，但增加了FNDC5和irisin表达以及一氧化氮产生。地塞米松促进了C2C12肌管中β-catenin和总p38的表达。2.5-20微克/毫升的CRE-Ter逆转了β-catenin表达的增加，而2.5微克/毫升逆转了总p38表达。交叉实验进一步揭示，来自C2C12肌管的条件培养基增强了MC3T3-E1成骨细胞中骨钙素的表达。使用CB-Dock2进行的分子对接模拟显示，每个姜黄素类化合物分子与irisin之间存在强相互作用。因此，CRE-Ter可能刺激成骨细胞分化、改善肌管萎缩并增加irisin表达，表明其在骨质疏松症、肌少症和骨肌少症中的治疗潜力。
